micro_counts.protocol: One native instructions:u count at zero and five million iterations; same source except loop bound; CPU 2 and identical environment; not a timing distribution

mixed_confirmation.warmup: one run per binary; not measured

main_code_comparison.protocol: Main executor disassembly excluding instruction addresses, resolved symbolic branch addresses and RIP-relative relocation displacements; symbolic targets and offsets retained.

without_data_target_comments.note: Also remove objdump resolved data-target comments, which label anonymous jump tables relative to the nearest named rodata symbol. Direct branch/call symbolic names and offsets remain. This compares instruction sequences, not relocated data contents.

samples.case: opaque transient and ordinary shared-owner unit regressions

native_profile.note: Flat sampled native cycle attribution; no whole-command instruction count or absolute timing comparison is inferred from this profiled run.

initial_differential_failure.status: harness configuration mismatch; candidate and baseline agree
initial_differential_failure.reason: Host PHP defaults exception_ignore_args to 1; CLI RPHP defaults to 0. Both explicit settings produce exact output for PHP/baseline/candidate. Subsequent differential runner pins 1 for both, matching the embedding regression tests.

candidate_tree: root-pinned borrowed ownership-tree observation; opaque transient visitor handles remain owned

protocol.application: Two separate CPU-2 windows, each PHP/baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline/PHP, fresh result cache each run, OS caches warm. No window pooling. Actual analysis timers; hardware counts cover the entire command. Five files and twenty findings, matching exit/stdout/stderr.
protocol.controls: All valid samples retained. First short controls, five seeded long pairs, then separate five-pair confirmations for scalar frames and property reads. Five deep pairs per size and five mixed 100-million-iteration pairs. No window pooling.
protocol.memory: Memcheck with system heap routing; three minimal/deep PHP reference-escape programs and both Rust observer ownership unit regressions. Zero invalid-memory errors. Leak detection was not enabled.
protocol.limits: 6 GiB aggregate, zero swap, exclusive lock, all processes inherit boundary. Native x86-64 only; no new JIT lowering or ABI.

limitations: Instruction and time gains are targeted to PHPStan and deep release; not an all-workloads speedup.

Scalar and property controls regress in independent confirmations by about 4.07 and 2.70 percent. Their median instructions are unchanged. Main executor size and instruction sequence after data-address normalization remain unchanged, but code and jump-table placement changes; exact hardware cause is not established.

The integrating task explicitly accepts these two control tradeoffs for a repeatable 2.45-billion-instruction PHPStan reduction, favorable target time windows, deep-release improvement, and gains in shared/self/mixed controls. Both regressions remain controls for later checkpoints.

The initial expanded differential failure is a harness configuration mismatch, preserved as a failed job. PHP, baseline and candidate agree for both explicit exception_ignore_args settings; corrected differential gate pins 1 for both CLI runtimes. PHPStan retains its existing explicit setting 0.
Existing echo callable lifetime is independently recorded and not changed here.

No ARM64 native performance evidence, whole-application allocation count or JIT/frame ABI change. Native cycle sampling is a separate attribution run and is not mixed with hardware instruction measurements.
